title: SMOK Zrex RF Replacement Pods 0.8ohm 2ml - 3 Pods
description: The SMOK Zrex RF Refillable Pods are the perfect companion for your SMOK Zrex RF Pod Kit, providing a seamless and satisfying MTL (Mouth To Lung) vaping experience. Each pod boasts a 2ml e-liquid capacity, allowing you to enjoy your favourite e-liquids without the need for constant refills. The side-fill design of the Zrex RF pods ensures that refilling is quick, easy, and mess-free. Simply open the side port and fill the pod with your preferred e-liquid. The built-in mesh coil technology heats the e-liquid evenly, delivering rich and authentic flavours with every puff. When the coil reaches the end of its lifespan, replacing the entire pod is a breeze, ensuring that you can continue to enjoy a consistent and flavourful vaping experience. These refillable pods are designed specifically for the SMOK Zrex RF Pod Kit, ensuring a perfect fit and optimal performance. Whether you’re a new vaper or an experienced user, the SMOK Zrex RF Refillable Pods offer the convenience and quality you need for an enjoyable MTL vaping experience. Please note: When filling your pod with e-liquid for the first time, allow the pod to sit for ten minutes before use. This will allow the e-liquid to better saturate the wicking material, a type of cotton, to prevent dry hits and ensure the best flavour and performance from your coil.
